title: Expose receipt-to-invoice allocation evidence in sales-invoice and customer workflows
description: Expose ERP-073 customer receipt-to-sales-invoice allocations in existing customer sales-invoice detail and customer-facing workflows. Keep invoice gross evidence, receipt allocation evidence and unallocated amounts separately labeled. Do not infer a receivable balance, mutate source records, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: Customer sales-invoice detail exposes active ERP-073 receipt allocations, allocated count and unallocated or unavailable context using only persisted ERP-073 rows.
Customer sales-invoice lists expose bounded receipt-allocation summaries without issuing a database or storage query per row.
Existing customer-receipt workflows expose explicit ERP-073 invoice allocations and remaining receipt evidence without replacing or duplicating the canonical FinanceReceipt record.

The reconciliation view displays invoice gross, explicitly allocated-receipt and arithmetic unallocated evidence in separate labeled fields and does not net unrelated evidence into an asserted receivable or settlement balance.
Amounts are grouped by currency; different currencies are never combined, converted or reassigned without an authoritative persisted conversion already belonging to the source evidence.
Draft and voided invoices and voided receipt allocations are distinguished from active recorded evidence; inactive evidence is excluded from active totals but remains inspectable in history.
Customer, currency or source-link inconsistencies in historical evidence are displayed as invalid or unavailable and are not silently repaired, reassigned or merged.
Missing receipt-allocation evidence is shown as none or unknown and is never converted into paid, settled, outstanding, overdue, recognized or posted status.
The UI and documentation state that this is an operational evidence view, not a general ledger, legal Customer statement, tax filing, payment authorization or settlement confirmation.
The workflow is read-only and does not update invoices, allocations, receipts, Sales Orders, Customers, balances, finance or tax records.
Queries are bounded or paged, avoid per-row access and reuse ERP-053, ERP-055 and ERP-073 semantics rather than adding another reconciliation engine.

Unit and integration tests cover no evidence, partial and full receipt allocations, void and invalid history, multiple Customers and currencies, bounded queries and source-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is recorded as deferred during development.

scenarios: Open a customer sales-invoice with partial ERP-073 receipt allocation evidence and verify invoice gross, allocated and unallocated amounts remain separately labeled in one currency.
Inspect an invoice with draft, voided, mismatched or missing receipt-allocation evidence and verify it is not presented as paid, settled, outstanding or overdue and that no source record changes.

human_gate.reason: Read-only presentation of repository receipt-allocation evidence. No real receipt handling, bank access, accounting posting, production mutation, deployment or release is authorized.
